notes: Receive Funds: any client can now be chosen, including one with no investment in the chosen product yet (for example a Parkview investor buying into a Hansen trust) — their investment in the product is created with the first deposit, with bank details copied from one of their other investments if wanted. The new certificate number is now added automatically to the product investment's certificate numbers (optional per receipt, the previous value is reported, and the field stays editable on the investment).
